run_generate_visualization: run the script to generate visualization figures for TensorFlow datasets
run_generate_visualization_datasets: run the script with a comma-separated list of specific datasets to generate figures for
run_generate_visualization_dst_dir: run the script and save generated visualization images to a custom destination directory
run_generate_visualization_overwrite: run the script with overwrite enabled to replace existing visualization images
run_generate_visualization_all: run the script without specifying datasets to generate figures for all available datasets
